submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole fires when the current token is the constrained completion of the preceding one or two tokens: the second half of a fixed phrase or collocation ('fell silent', 'through Sunday', 'on average', 'at sea level', 'According to the'), a compound or split subword ('protons', 'Seine', 'Photosynthesis'), or the obligatory filler of a slot opened by the previous head ('def' name, 'WHERE' condition, 'one' quantifier, list copula). The identical token in an open context where many continuations are possible ('Her silent', 'alien egg', 'They add', 'bought the') fires weakly or not at all, and distant words outside the local frame do not gate it.
